entries.5d6749f07bd5d4cb: The business manufactures and sells thin electric wires used inside electronic devices, bendable circuit boards (flexible printed circuits), fluororesin products and other products. Its main products are electronic wires, electron beam irradiation products, flexible printed circuits, fluororesin products, rivets and screws, metal parts, and chemical products. Its major affiliates include the domestic consolidated subsidiary Techno Associe Co., Ltd., as well as overseas consolidated subsidiaries such as Judd Wire, Inc. in the United States, SEI Electronic Components (Vietnam) Limited in Vietnam, and Sumitomo Electric (Suzhou) Electron Beam Products Co., Ltd. in China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥350,638 million (¥327,147 million in the previous year), making it the fourth largest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥409,096 million, an increase of ¥31,848 million (8.4%) from the previous year, due to higher demand for flexible printed circuits from major customers. Number of employees was 21,169 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.78df8d080664d57b: Electrical and Power Construction and Engineering
entries.b5b99a9cff4b98e8: The business manufactures and sells electric wires and cables for transmitting electricity, power equipment such as substation and switchgear, and winding wire used in motors, and also undertakes electrical construction work. Its main products are conductive products, power transmission and distribution wires, cables and equipment, winding wire, air springs, power equipment such as substation equipment and control systems, beam and vacuum application equipment, electrical and power construction and engineering, metal porous bodies, and metal materials for electronic components. Its major affiliates include the domestic consolidated subsidiaries Nissin Electric Co., Ltd. (substation and switchgear, among others), Sumitomo Electric Wintec, Inc. (winding wire), and Juden HST Cable Co., Ltd., as well as overseas consolidated subsidiaries such as Sumitomo Electric UK Power Cables Limited in the United Kingdom. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,142,598 million (¥1,048,068 million in the previous year), making it the second largest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥1,178,780 million, an increase of ¥97,436 million (9.0%) from the previous year, due to growth in power cables, flat rectangular winding wire for electric vehicle motors, substation equipment at Nissin Electric Co., Ltd., and electrical construction work at Sumitomo Denko Setsubi Co., Ltd. The shares of Sumitomo Denko Setsubi Co., Ltd. were transferred on March 24, 2026. Number of employees was 12,336 (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.d6682c604cd933d5: The business manufactures and sells electric wires and cables for transmitting electricity, power equipment such as substation and switchgear, and winding wire used in motors, and also undertakes electrical construction work.
entries.da0cdf7177bdc87a: The business manufactures and sells wire harnesses, which carry electricity and signals through automobiles, and anti-vibration rubber and hoses that suppress vibration and noise. It is the segment with the largest revenue from external customers among the five reportable segments. Its main products are wire harnesses, anti-vibration rubber and automotive hoses, automotive electrical components, and network and system products such as traffic control products. Its major affiliates include the domestic consolidated subsidiaries Sumitomo Wiring Systems, Ltd. and Sumitomo Riko Company Limited, and overseas consolidated subsidiaries such as Sumitomo Electric Wiring Systems, Inc. in the United States and Sumitomo Electric Bordnetze S.A. in Germany; Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Ltd. is also listed as a domestic equity-method affiliate. Sumitomo Riko Company Limited became a wholly owned subsidiary in February 2026. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,935,389 million (¥2,732,581 million in the previous year), and the company's overall revenue was ¥5,110,171 million. Of this, revenue from external customers classified as 'wire harnesses' in the information by product and service was ¥2,281,700 million. Revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥2,937,168 million, an increase of ¥202,438 million (7.4%) from the previous year, as demand for wire harnesses and anti-vibration rubber remained firm. Number of employees was 244,192 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.dcaa8a8dd6b46a7d: The business manufactures and sells optical fibers and cables, equipment that connects data centers and communication networks, and components that convert light and electricity (optical and electronic devices). Its main products are optical fiber cables, communication cables and equipment, optical fusion splicers, optical and electronic device products such as optical data link and wireless communication devices, compound semiconductors, and access network equipment (GE-PON, set-top boxes, CATV-related products, etc.). Its major affiliates include the domestic consolidated subsidiary Sumitomo Electric Device Innovations, Inc. and the overseas consolidated subsidiary Sumitomo Electric Lightwave Corp. in the United States. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥315,030 million (¥218,401 million in the previous year), making it the smallest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥326,632 million, an increase of ¥103,356 million (46.3%) from the previous year, as demand for optical wiring products, optical cables and optical devices for data centers rose against the backdrop of the expanding generative AI market. Number of employees was 9,240 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.eb0336ca9c99761a: Power Transmission and Distribution Wires, Cables and Equipment
entries.ec3780fbf717daf8: The business manufactures and sells materials and parts used at manufacturing sites, such as steel products for reinforced concrete and precision springs, tools and sintered parts. Although its name includes 'Other', it is one of the reportable segments. Its main products are PC steel, steel wire for precision springs, steel cord, cemented carbide tools, diamond and CBN tools, optical components for lasers, sintered parts, and semiconductor heat-dissipating substrates. Its major affiliates include the domestic consolidated subsidiaries Sumitomo Electric Hardmetal Corp., Tochigi Sumitomo Electric Co., Ltd., Hokkaido Juden Seimitsu Co., Ltd. and Sumitomo Electric Sintered Alloy, Ltd., as well as PT Sumiden Cerasi Wire Products in Indonesia. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥366,516 million (¥353,592 million in the previous year), making it the third largest of the five reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥388,413 million, an increase of ¥15,746 million (4.2%) from the previous year, due to higher sales of cemented carbide products and diamond and CBN products. Number of employees was 16,035 (as of March 31, 2026).
